There are many shops in the food villa with food stalls, clothes stalls, and accessories for you to shop from. While the prices are a bit higher than many markets, you can still afford to buy and enjoy your food here. It is always difficult to find a parking spot, despite the fact that there are many parking areas.

My family's favorite stall is Home Style Fried Rice, which is open only in the evening. In this stall, you can choose from a variety of Fried Rice options. In our family, we love Chinese sausage fried rice, salty fish friend rice, and crispy pork fried rice.

Usually, I’m not a big fan of non air-conditioned places as the heat in Bangkok is unbearable. However, this might be my first 5-star rating of a flea market. On the surface, it doesn’t see to be too great, but all the shops are excellent. Not only does it have some of my favorite shops, but the others also make really high quality and good-tasting food.

I love coming here! The food is always delicious, and there’s plenty of parking available. It’s never too crowded, which makes the dining experience even better. My favorite dish is the grilled salmon belly – it’s perfectly cooked and full of flavor. They offer a great variety, so there’s something for everyone. Lately, they’ve even had live music on some days, which adds to the nice atmosphere. Highly recommend Effotae for a tasty and relaxing meal.

Food Villa Ratchaphruek is a great local spot with plenty of street food options, especially during the evenings when the market comes alive with various vendors and even live music. It’s a smaller market compared to Thonburi Market Place but has its charm. Daytime visitors can enjoy fresh and affordable seafood, while evenings offer a wide variety of snacks, meals, and drinks. The market has convenience stores, a dental clinic, drugstores, Starbucks, and even pet shops, making it pretty versatile. It’s not air-conditioned, but it stays relatively cool inside. Parking is ample, which is a big plus. Overall, it’s a cozy, laid-back market for both quick bites and casual dinners.

text: This market redefines the word "market" by being open all day, without the need to wait for closing time like typical markets. There's a huge variety of food, both expensive and cheap. The staff are friendly, and there's plenty of seating. It's a market where the owners are considerate of the users and the users are also considerate. Therefore, if any problems arise, the owners will quickly resolve them, which I personally appreciate. I usually drive from Sathorn to have lunch and dinner here every day. I'm very impressed with this market. They have everything from savory dishes and desserts to fruits and fresh produce. There are also several bubble tea vendors; I personally like Bear House. There's plenty of parking, but it can get congested on weekends due to traffic. People tend to slow down and wait for spaces. If you have to circle around to find parking inside, you might need to be understanding of the situation. Overall, it's a great market, earning it 5 stars.
